tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Window background behind every screen; the ground the conversation scrolls on.

tokens.name: plumage
tokens.usage: Surfaces that hold content: cards, tool cards, lists, sidebars of a split view.

tokens.name: plumage-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, chips, key caps, the selected row.

tokens.name: quill
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, input borders.

tokens.name: quill-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must read as a control edge (inputs, unchecked boxes, switch tracks); 3:1 on plumage.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on ink, plumage and plumage-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on ink and plumage (≥ 4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Hints, placeholders, timestamps; on ink and plumage (≥ 4.5:1 on plumage).

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: The accent as text, icons and focus marks: links, the active tab underline, tool icons. On ink and plumage.

tokens.name: sheen-strong
tokens.usage: Fills of the one primary action per screen (Primary button, send button). Carries on-sheen text.

tokens.name: sheen-teal
tokens.usage: Second stop of the iridescent gradient (send button, working dot). Never alone as text.

tokens.name: sheen-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind sheen text: selected chips, plan card halo, hunk headers.

tokens.name: on-sheen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sheen-strong fills (4.9:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, on every surface (≥ 3:1).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Waits on you: permission requests, peak hours, the stop button. As text on ink and plumage.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Background of permission cards and the peak banner.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ember fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done and connected: check marks, merged, MCP connected. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always with an icon or word; differs from success in lightness.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Background of added lines in diffs.

tokens.name: diff-remove
tokens.usage: Background of removed lines in diffs.

tokens.usage: Project colour: monogram fill and the user's bubble tint.
